name: Marshmallow
description: A soft, pillowy pastel theme with subtle neumorphic depth — dusty-lavender accents on warm marshmallow-cream surfaces, gentle raised/inset 3D shadows (and recessed wells) on buttons, cards, fields, switch & segmented controls, generous rounding, and Space Grotesk display & headings with Nunito body.
